items.title: Start of Unterhaltsvorschuss payments for Marie
items.quote: für Ihre Tochter Marie zahlen wir ab dem 01.11.2026 Unterhaltsvorschuss nach dem Unterhaltsvorschussgesetz in Höhe von 293,00 € monatlich.
items.computation: The letter states the benefit is paid from 01.11.2026 onward at 293,00 € per month; this is the start date stated in the letter, not a counted deadline.

items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against the decision
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, Schlossplatz 7, 55469 Musterbach im Hunsrück); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, sent by ordinary post by a social-law authority (Jugendamt). Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after posting: Mon 23.11.2026 (no weekend adjustment for this deemed-delivery rule). Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after delivery, i.e. 24.11.2026, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the same-numbered day: Wed 23.12.2026. That day is a regular working day in Rheinland-Pfalz (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X), so the deadline stays at 23.12.2026.

warnings: The letter also asks to report immediately ('sofort') if the father pays maintenance directly or if the family moves, but gives no fixed calendar deadline for that notification — it should be done as soon as either event occurs.

The IBAN printed in the letter (DE54 5605 0180 0008 2004 00) belongs to the authority and is not an instruction to pay anything from this letter; it is shown only for completeness and does not need action.
